subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Engine Control Unit
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Engine Control Unit.

hook.text: Your car's engine is controlled by a computer that makes hundreds of decisions every second.

buildup.text: The ECU reads data from dozens of sensors—air temperature, throttle position, oxygen levels, RPM.

discovery.text: It adjusts fuel injection, spark timing, and valve lift in real time to balance power and efficiency.

twist.text: Before ECUs, carburetors mixed fuel mechanically. They were imprecise and wasted a lot of gasoline.

climax.text: Modern ECUs also monitor emissions and trigger the check engine light when something goes wrong.

punchline.text: Your engine's brain processes more data than you think.

quiz.question: What did ECUs replace in fuel delivery?
